subject.title: fix(imessage): prevent duplicate messages after delayed sends

question: Should OpenClaw accept up to 30 additional seconds of send wait time so imsg’s delayed fallback can report its actual delivery result instead of causing callers to retry an ambiguous timeout?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the runtime tradeoff for existing configurations that used `probeTimeoutMs` as a short practical send deadline; source and terminal evidence support the fix, but the acceptable latency policy is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Accept the delivery-first timeout floor
options.body: After rebasing and refreshing the focused proof, retain the 180-second floor so configured probe timeouts cannot recreate the duplicate-message timeout boundary.

options.title: Preserve shorter configured send failures
options.body: Decline the floor and keep the prior behavior, accepting that a successful delayed fallback can still be reported as a timeout and retried by callers.

recommendation.title: Accept the delivery-first timeout floor
recommendation.body: After rebasing and refreshing the focused proof, retain the 180-second floor so configured probe timeouts cannot recreate the duplicate-message timeout boundary.
